neighbours.label: The mark just before a vowel-initial word, where the article or elision requires a vowel: French l’ and d’, and 'an “'. Possessive ’s, 'a “' and non-elided French stay quiet.
fire: Le ministre regrette aujourd’hui l’absence de dialogue.
Ces familles sont loin d’oublier les inondations.
The report called it an “unusual oversight” by the board.
Her editor inserted an “s” at the end of the word.
Je vois encore l’ombre de ce grand arbre.
Les habitants ont peur d’être chassés de la ville.
Critics described the show as an “uneven experiment” at best.
Il a posé la clé sur l’étagère de la cuisine.
quiet: Le ministre regrette aujourd’hui la fin du dialogue.
Ces familles sont loin de partir après les inondations.
The report called it a “serious oversight” by the board.
Her editor’s friend changed the end of the word.
Je vois encore la forme de ce grand arbre.
Les habitants ont peur de partir de la ville.
Critics described the show as a “messy experiment” at best.
Il a posé la clé sur la table de la cuisine.

predictions: 8/8 fire, 0 near misses. The output promotes vowel-initial pieces (enes, ees, aqu, oor), which is what suggested this label.
notes: Probes: l’, d’ 0.66-0.72; 'an “' 0.57-0.88; 'a “' under 0.01, la and de 0.05, possessive ’s under 0.01. This pattern unifies the card's two peak tokens (’ x21, ' “' x8) and is tested on new phrases.
